messages.content: Help me update the HBase mapping configuration for a specific file named 'user-mapping.yml' with a new configuration object `newMappingConfig` that does not change the outer adapter key?

function.name: HbaseAdapter_updateConfig
function.description: Updates the HBase mapping configuration for a given file name with the provided mapping configuration, ensuring the outer adapter key remains unchanged. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

fileName.description: The name of the file for which the mapping configuration is to be updated. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

config.description: The new mapping configuration object to be used for the update. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
